QuestInfo.name: Lumiere Light Show
QuestInfo.0: Your plan to drive Hilla away from #m130000000# was relatively successful.
QuestInfo.1: Though your abilities are not anywhere near what they used to be, the #rfake skill effect show#K produced by #p1401000# and the rest of the #m150000000# crew was rather effective in driving Hilla off. You should go talk to #b#p1401000##k to say thanks.
QuestInfo.2: #p1401000# scolded you for putting on such a big production, but he's just being an old codger. The greatest thief of all time should make an entrance!

0.0: That she-witch Hilla will think twice about crossing paths with myself or the #p1101000# Knights for a while. Not a bad debut for this new generation either...
0.1: It's a good thing it was only Hilla. If any of the REAL commanders had been there, I would have been in some serious trouble. The Black Mage's curse had some nasty effects on my strength.
0.2: I can't take all the credit for that performance. I should go say thanks to #b#p1401000##k for putting together that little light show with the skill effects.

yes.0: #p1401000#!\r\n#b(Go into the Lumiere to meet Gaston.)#k

no.0: What am I thinking? That was his job! I'll just buy him a new egg timer later. He loves those.

1.0: Congratulations on a successful mission, master. Hilla will not be so fast to concoct another scheme when she realizes she was fooled by a level 10 thief. \r\n#L0##bWhat goes around comes around, my good man. Tricks are a legitimate strategy in any battle.#l\n#k
1.1: Perhaps next time, you will think to be a little less flippant with your life. Provoking a commander of the Black Mage at this time could easily turn into a one-way return ticket to the grave. \r\n#L0##bI had to look good! It was my big debut! I needed some cool flashy effects and a tough spiel...#l\n#k
1.2: Your love of flashy things is quite obvious, looking at the #m150000000#, but take care not to risk your life so frivolously in the future, will you? My position here relies on that.
